'''Rogis''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who took a [[Bounty/Legends|commission]] to hunt [[Ellylyn]]. Rogis tracked Ellylyn to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], and almost killed his quarry by using a [[Mon Cal Defenses]] [[Mini-Torpedo Launcher]].<ref name="GFT" />
